# ops upper

upper-case lines

This command is experimental: it may change or be removed in any release.

## Usage

```
ops upper
```

## Global Flags

- `-h, --help` — print help
- `-v, --verbose` — say more; repeat to count: -vvv
- `--color` `string` — when to color (default `auto`) (one of auto, always, never)

## Stdin

Reads lines of text from stdin.
